description: Copy to skills/profiles/docker.json — Web UI / API deployment inside Docker. Disables host-integrated tools (OpenCode, SSH, Docker socket control, MCP sidecars, phone, Spotify OAuth, printer, shell on host). Tune for your setup; re-enable MCP or docker_control only if you mount docker.sock. Set JARVIS_TOOL_PROFILE=docker in cloud.env and local.env (or via compose environment).
